answer: Stake-per-identity with slashing is the mechanism: each agent identity posts a bond held while it earns, and proven double-attestation or forged receipts burn it. Ten thousand identities means funding ten thousand bonds and keeping them solvent, so swarm cost scales linearly instead of near zero like free keys. Identities also carry an untransferable jade reputation, so bought accounts start cold. The mesa of incentives is the point: honest agents recover stake, while a ring colluding on a verifiable lie forfeits every deposit at once, making a relic of settled history the only cheap way in.
